band.authority: KIE common rules rule 12; adopted as Skill 71's native authoring target by owner Decision 1 (2026-10-15), superseding Amendment 6 Part C wherever the two conflict.
band.semantics: Below the floor fails at the prompt stage (budget exit 3, naming the characters to ADD and the count to the 95 percent target); above the maximum fails (budget exit 4, naming the characters to CUT); floor-to-target passes with a below-target warning; in band passes (budget exit 0). Verbatim fields are exempt from the floor. Models with no recorded maximum render no band verdict (status UNKNOWN, percent_of_max null); the 2,000-character tripwire remains their operative short-prompt flag.

cap_status_semantics.NOT_PUBLISHED: Provenance: the maximum is recorded from provider documentation and is not owner-confirmed. Under Decision 1 the band applies to the recorded maximum in full; cap status no longer carries overflow semantics.
cap_status_semantics.OWNER_CONFIRMED: Provenance: the maximum is owner-confirmed. Under Decision 1 the band applies to the recorded maximum in full; cap status no longer carries overflow semantics.
cap_status_semantics.UNKNOWN: No maximum is recorded: no band verdict is rendered and percent_of_max is null (FIX-PLAN C6).
cap_status_semantics.VERIFIED: Provenance: the maximum is verified. The band's ceiling is the maximum itself.

counting_convention: NFC-normalized, trimmed, Unicode code points, per Image Guide v5 (FIX-PLAN conflict N3). The shared enforcer counts len(text.strip()); the two counts can differ and are not interchangeable.

default.source: No policy entry matched the model id. Ceiling not enforced; percent_of_max recorded as null.

models.source: GPT Image 2.5 cap 20,000 per KIE docs 2026-09-09 as recorded by Skill 66; NOT owner-confirmed (FIX-PLAN Part C-rule 5). Under the Decision 1 band: floor 16,000 (80 percent), target 19,000 (95 percent).

Skill 66: GPT Image 2 authoritative cap is 25,000, OWNER_CONFIRMED 2026-08-27. The shared enforcer's embedded table lists 20,000, which Skill 66 calls stale; the owner-confirmed value governs inside Skill 71 until Trevor rules otherwise (FIX-PLAN C8, Part C-rule 5). The divergence is also pinned in references/external-authorities.json. Under the Decision 1 band: floor 20,000 (80 percent), target 23,750 (95 percent); the former warn-only overflow semantics are superseded.

Skill 66 records the Qwen class limit as 4.5K TOKENS. Token-limited models are checked in tokens, never converted to a fake character cap; this validator has no tokenizer and does not judge token counts (Part C-rule 2). Character telemetry is still recorded.

purpose: Prompt-budget policy layer for Skill 71 (FIX-PLAN Amendment 6, Part C; length doctrine superseded by owner Decision 1, 2026-10-15). The KIE rule 12 band is Skill 71's native authoring target: author each prompt to 95 to 100 percent of the model's recorded maximum, never below the 80 percent floor, by genuine specification only. This file records each model's maximum, the policy layer's operative numbers; cap_status is retained as provenance only and no longer carries overflow semantics.
tripwire_meaning: A complete prompt under tripwire_chars is flagged for manual element re-inspection by the reviewer, recorded in the review file. It is NOT an automatic failure. Under Decision 1 the tripwire is retained as the operative short-prompt flag for models with no recorded maximum. Basis: the guide's four measured complete teaching prompts run 9,475 to 9,906 characters; no complete prompt in this system has been observed below roughly 9,000.
